title: Treadmill incline intervals
terrain: treadmill, 8-10% incline, climb only, zero descent (Milan, last indoor access)
coachNotes: Moved forward from Wednesday: mountain departure is now Wed morning, so tonight is the last treadmill access. Two wins from the swap. The outdoor fallback would have banked roughly 550m of walk-down descent in a week already running +65% on descent volume, and this way it is zero. And the gap to Saturday's traverse goes from 48h to 72h, which is the whole reason the session was cut to 6 reps in the first place. Six reps stands, no extend rule: the number that matters this week is how fresh your quads are Saturday morning, not what tonight scored. Garmin on-watch target 250-290. Evening session on 6h09 of sleep, so cool down properly, no late heavy meal, and protect the night. Thursday is still a full rest day. MEASUREMENT: report the actual intervals.icu load tonight. Family away means no time pressure, which removes the confound behind the 23 July shortfall (42 against 65 planned at RPE 8). Near 76 and the load model is calibrated. Near 60 and treadmill incline work is over-priced across every future quality day, and the CTL projection is optimistic.
